answers.core: This deals with the very fundamental way users use the Godot editor to move, scale, and rotate 2D objects. Since the same Blender-inspired approach works built-in in Godot's 3D editor, it wouldn't make sense to have this work in the 2D editor via a separate add-on.
answers.workaround: This is a core usability and is expected to be used very often by the people that already use this approach https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1215 in the 3D editor.

title: Add Blender-inspired transform tools in the 2D editor
